Rows of one source code list

Source: R/code-lists.R
soil_code_list.Rd

The rows of a code list (GET /code-lists/{code_list}), verbatim: one row per source row, with its source dataset and row number. A code may appear once per source dataset (the same triple in each package).

Usage

soil_code_list(
  soil = soil_session(),
  name,
  attribute = NULL,
  code = NULL,
  source_dataset = NULL
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted (the name may then be given first: soil_code_list("SOTWIS_codes")). Client-side: not sent to the API.

name

The code list ("SOTWIS_codes"). API path parameter {code_list} of GET /code-lists/{code_list}.

attribute

Source attributes (ATTRIBUTE, e.g. "LNDF"), NULL for all. API query parameter attribute.

code

Codes (CODE), NULL for all. API query parameter code.

source_dataset

One source dataset (record id or name), NULL for all. API query parameter source_dataset.

Value

A data frame: attribute, code, description, source_record_id, source_dataset_name, source_table, source_row_number (integer), provider_code. An unknown list raises soilhub_not_found_error.

Details

Rights: soil:summary. Capability: code_lists.

See also

Other discovery: soil_api_info(), soil_capabilities(), soil_citations(), soil_code_lists(), soil_countries(), soil_country(), soil_dataset(), soil_datasets(), soil_formats(), soil_ttr_flag_legend(), soil_variable_mappings(), soil_variables()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
soil_code_list(soil, "SOTWIS_codes", attribute = "LNDF")
} # }
